messages:
emma: deploy-bot failed to promote RC -> staging/org. ECR put-image rejected (immutability) and cosign verification missing after attempted manifest copy.

deploy-bot: automated: publish attempt -> aws-ecr error 409: TagAlreadyExists; cosign verify: no attestation found for manifest sha256:cc9a...99. target repo `redwood/payments`, attempted tag `rc-2026-03-21-2`.

omar: is this the same tag reused from CI?

emma: yes, CI re-used `rc-2026-03-21-2`. builder wrote to `ci-redwood/payments`. when deploy-bot tried to mirror into org account the org registry refused overwriting tag and the attestation blob wasn't propagated by the simple manifest copy.

priya: short options: (1) manual pull-by-digest and put-image into org account with correct KMS + reattach cosign blob, (2) pin staging deployment to the CI digest so QA can continue, (3) rollback to previous stable digest. Prod promotion stays blocked until attestation + KMS checked.

infra-bot: policy note: cross-account pushes must use org KMS and include attestation. Automated fallback to staging digest-pin allowed with explicit approver reaction.

ops-bot: action: please react :white_check_mark: to approve staging digest pin. Prod promotions will be blocked until `prod_release_ok=true` for this artifact.

release-manager: we have a production change window in ~1h. If we manual republish + reattach attestation within 40m we keep it. If not, slide window.

priya: I'll do the pin for staging now so QA isn't blocked, and then perform manual republish to org account as soon as QA signs off. Command I'll use for manual republish:```
# infra account
aws ecr batch-get-image --registry-id 111111111111 --repository-name ci-redwood/payments --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:cc9a...99
  | jq -r .images[0].imageManifest > /tmp/manifest.json
aws ecr put-image --registry-id 222222222222 --repository-name redwood/payments --image-tag rc-2026-03-21-2 --image-manifest file:///tmp/manifest.json --kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:...
# then reattach cosign attestation blob and verify
cosign attach-blob --name redwood/payments@sha256:cc9a...99 --output attestation.json attestation.payload
cosign verify-blob --signature attestation.json --payload-file /tmp/manifest.json
```

qa-bot: smoke tests queued against digest sha256:cc9a...99. ETA ~6m.

omar: approve staging pin. ops-bot please set `staging_pinned_digest=sha256:cc9a...99`.

ops-bot: flag set. Prod promotions suspended.

qa-bot: smoke passed (4/4). QA signs off.

priya: starting manual republish now; will reattach attestation and run cosign verify.

deploy-bot: reminder: put-image does not automatically move attestations. Must attach or cosign in target account.

priya: manual put-image done, attached attestation, cosign verify OK. pushed tag `rc-2026-03-21-2` into org account.

ops-bot: prod_release_ok=true for artifact sha256:cc9a...99.

release-manager: plan for prod: (1) update prod manifests to imageDigest sha256:cc9a...99, (2) dry-run apply to prod-canary, (3) if green -> progressive rollout 5%->50%->100% with 10m waits and rollback criteria set. I'll kick off at T-20m before window.

omar: opening follow-up ticket DEPLOY-4901 to prevent CI reuse of promotion tags and ensure deploy-bot preserves attestation during cross-account mirror.

emma: adding note to release notes: "Payments: promoted to staging pinned by digest due to registry immutability; manual org republish + attestation reattach performed for prod promotion."

release-manager: thanks all. keeping thread until rollout completes.
